text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Policy

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: The guidelines set out in this section cover

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: provincial identification on all vehicles and equip-

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: ment. The new markings will replace existing

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: government decals. Component and branch

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: markings will not be permitted, allowing greater

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: flexibility in the use of pooled vehicles within

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: a ministry.

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: All government vehicles and equipment must be

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: marked with the provincial signature (Symbol and

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: provincial logotype), ministerial signature (pro-

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: vincial logotype and name of ministry) and a unit

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: number. In addition, the rear of all trucks, and

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: trailers, and any vehicles operating under particu-

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: larly hazardous conditions must be marked with

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: silver-white reflective striping.

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: The way in which the signatures and unit numbers

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: are placed varies according to the space available

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: on different types of vehicles and equipment.

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Marking formats are recommended guidelines.

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: They cannot anticipate every marking situation

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: because of the great variety of vehicles and equip-

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: ment used by the Province. Any questions should

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: be addressed to the designated Visual Identity

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Officer in your ministry.

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Province of British Columbia Visual Identity Program
